idea-plugin.name: Affected
idea-plugin.description:
Run only what your change can affect.

Affected maps changed source files to build modules and runs their tests, build or configured static analysis. It can also check direct consumers after a public API change. Unrelated modules are skipped. Compatible modules inside one build root share one IDE Run tab; independent build roots run concurrently. After a successful full run, compatible Gradle JVM, Android unit-test and Maven Surefire and Failsafe runs use independent local bytecode maps to narrow Jupiter and Vintage test classes, including reusable and isolated parallel Maven forks. Both adapters select every mapped affected class; uncertain cases keep the original full task or Maven goal. One concise Run-output line explains the exact, proven-empty or full-fallback decision.

Workflow
  • The toolbar matrix shows the current affected scope.
  • Run from the toolbar, Run menu, commit dialog, push check or optional MCP toolset.
  • Gradle and Maven use their IDE integrations; other systems run their command-line tools in the Run window.
  • No Affected config file: module graphs come from imported project models or standard manifests.
Supported project types
  • Gradle JVM and Android projects, including linked and composite builds, and Maven projects.
  • Cargo workspaces or packages, Go modules, and npm, Yarn or pnpm workspaces or packages.
  • .NET solutions and projects.
  • Single- or multi-package Python, Composer and Bundler repositories.
  • CMake projects with executable or library targets.
Recognised languages: Kotlin, Java, Rust, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, F#, Visual Basic, Python, PHP, Ruby, C and C++. JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte and Razor files are recognised too.

With Git available, public API detection compares Kotlin and Java declarations; other supported systems conservatively classify non-test production and configuration changes. Optional consumer checking covers direct consumers only. Without Git, local source changes still work and are treated conservatively as possible API changes.

Requires a JetBrains IDE based on IntelliJ Platform 2025.3 or newer. The relevant IDE integration or command-line build tools must be installed.

Interface languages: English, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Turkish.

Affected has no server, account or telemetry and makes no network requests of its own. Error reporting only opens a prefilled GitHub issue for review.
